purpose: Read-only cross-branch 3D asset discovery and reuse triage; NOT a blanket approval or byte-complete all-history backup
work_protection: World PR #100 owner/runner/branch unmodified; NO mover or regenerar assets

sources.rehash_rule: sha256_recorded is prior evidence; not rehashed today
sources.historical_scope: 201 branch refs screened at changed-path level; 20 with source read; other 181 are not fully model-audited

coverage.known_historical_sampling_limit: selected_paths is not full recursive listing

statuses.USE_PRODUCTION: Use for documented existing role; any new placement still needs scene approval
statuses.INTEGRATED_REUSE_WITH_LIMITS: Current valid family; don't create duplicate encounter
statuses.WORLD_CANDIDATE_ONLY: Candidate visual; preserves old Tripo and game gates
statuses.REJECT_CURRENT_VISUAL: Current visual identity rejected, retain source for look-dev only
statuses.TECH_CANDIDATE_NOT_ART_APPROVED: Unity technical result is not owner's artistic approval
statuses.HISTORICAL_HOLD_FOR_DIRECT_REVIEW: Preserve pinned ref, no auto-restore or gameplay integration
statuses.REJECT_FOR_CURRENT_CANON: Historic negative family is not for promotion

records.name: Engendro de la Fisura — Bastion II
records.role: Bastion II common enemy spawnling; single gameplay hotspot engendro-valoria
records.verification: Every original/optimized/editable (and finished near/far when applicable) path from pipeline/tripo-art-brain/catalog.json was probed in main on 2026-10-25; all 12 of 12 files found. SHA-256 values are from provenance catalog, not freshly recalculated; quality approval remains separate.
records.limitations: El rostro aún es poco expresivo desde cámara de juego; comprobar frontal, ojos y línea mandíbula antes de modificar. Silueta encorvada útil pero cola/anatomía aún transmiten apariencia reptiliana; conservar identidad pequeña violeta, solo dos brazos y dos piernas. Rig/skinning y animaciones esqueléticas ausentes. La respiración por transform no equivale a un rig. No nuevo hotspot, campamento o nodo No tocar combate, recompensas, persistencia, interfaz ni escena de otro propietario No reemplazar la versión integrada antes de un A/B y QA independientes
